support.title: Triage a support inbox
support.summary: Read three tickets and route each to the right team.
support.instruction: Route all three support tickets. Payment, billing and refund issues go to Billing. Broken software and error messages go to Technical. Sign-in and profile changes go to Account. Read each ticket before selecting its team. Finish only after all three are routed.

items.title: Charged twice
items.text: My card was charged twice for the same monthly subscription.

items.title: Export keeps failing
items.text: Exporting the report gives a 500 error every time.

items.title: Update my sign-in email
items.text: I changed jobs and need to update the email on my profile.

reservation.title: Book a table
reservation.summary: Fill a reservation and ask before submitting it.
reservation.instruction: Reserve an indoor table for Ada, party of 2, at 18:00. Fill the guest name, party size, time, and seating fields. Submit the reservation; the operator must approve the submission. Finish only when the page shows the confirmation.

invoices.title: Review an invoice queue
invoices.summary: Match receipts, catch a duplicate, and approve a valid invoice.
invoices.instruction: Review all three invoices. Approve an invoice only when its amount matches the receipt and its invoice ID is not already paid. Flag an amount mismatch or a duplicate ID using the appropriate button. Approval requires operator consent. Finish when all three invoices are reviewed.

stock.title: Ship substitute stock
stock.summary: Match each order to an available substitute and approve each shipment.
stock.instruction: Ship both orders using available stock of the requested colour. Read the order and stock before choosing. Ask for approval for each shipment. Finish only after both shipments are recorded.

service.title: Schedule a service visit
service.summary: Set a date, choose a specialist, and approve the saved service request.
service.instruction: Schedule SERVICE-401 for PUMP-17 on 2026-11-12. Choose Sensor specialist and enter the service note Inspect drifting sensor. Submit the visit for operator approval. Finish only after the service visit is recorded.

files.title: Attach an intake note
files.summary: Approve a synthetic delivery note and verify its receipt for INTAKE-501.
files.instruction: Attach the approved fixture document to INTAKE-501 using attach_intake_note. This is a one-use local file task, not a browser click. The operator approves transfer. Finish only when the fixture has received the note.
